description: Mancubus spread and lost-soul charge; full actor dispatcher and playable game remain unfinished.

decisions.reference: Five unmodified original C actions plus FaceTarget, with controlled missile spawns; all 46 fields and ordered angle/sound/spawn traces match.
scope: All three spread patterns and angle wrap
Shadow facing with all 256 random starts
Unchanged spawned position and vertical velocity
Charge sound/flag/facing order and integer vertical aim
Raise and charge with absent targets
90 two-projectile traces from independent integer-table/RNG formulas
Initial half-step positions precede final spread angles/velocities
Sound/RNG timing, owner handles, timers and NOBLOCKMAP
Twelve absent/inactive/foreign actor, invalid action and callback-failure cases
Actual charge movement and sound-failure flag order

remaining: Tracer, arch-vile, pain-elemental and boss actions
Native host input/render pacing and UI/audio
